parent_states: Original v6 per-outer frozen recipe/decoder lexical/context/association and legal joint-state energy. Softmax at temperature1; MAP must replay all749 officialTrain correct and every original answer.
student_states: Product of same-outer current-question student probabilities for each legal assignment, clip probability floor1e-12, normalize over exactly the original parent legal assignments. No new learned parameter.
fusion: Arithmetic .5 parent state probability + .5 student state probability, MAP with original stable assignment order. Evaluate A and B separately, no grid or outer-based selection claimed as nested.
limits: All18people historically observed. Fixed full-scene fusion evaluation with independently trained A/B models; teacher/student dependence retained. Component comparison only, not uniform whole-system OOF. Original749 strong parent is retained unless independently justified by root.
